events.description: Phoebe Buffay says Chandler Bing is coming here.
Phoebe Buffay says Chandler Bing says that Chandler Bing has incredible news.
Phoebe Buffay says Chandler Bing has incredible news.

Phoebe Buffay suggests Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Phoebe Buffay should all act like they already know about Chandler Bing’s incredible news when Chandler Bing arrives.
Phoebe Buffay tells Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Rachel Green, and Monica Geller to never mind the plan to pretend to know about Chandler Bing’s news.
Phoebe Buffay says the abandoned plan to pretend to know about Chandler Bing’s news would have been really good.
Ross Geller asks what is going on regarding Chandler Bing’s news.
Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Monica Geller ask what Chandler Bing’s news is.
Chandler Bing says the day at work was a typical day at work.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing was inputting Chandler Bing’s numbers at work.
Chandler Bing says Big Al called Chandler Bing into Big Al’s office.
Chandler Bing says Big Al told Chandler Bing that Big Al wanted to make Chandler Bing the processing supervisor.
Chandler Bing says Big Al wanted to make Chandler Bing the processing supervisor.
Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Monica Geller say that Big Al’s offer to promote Chandler Bing to processing supervisor is great.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing quit Chandler Bing’s job.
Chandler Bing says the job at the processing company was supposed to be a temp job.
Monica Geller says Chandler Bing has been at that job for five years.
Chandler Bing says that if Chandler Bing took the promotion, it would be like admitting that the current job is what Chandler Bing actually does.
Phoebe Buffay asks whether the promotion would be a lot more money.
Chandler Bing says the amount of money in the promotion does not matter.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing does not want to be the kind of person who stays in the office until midnight worrying about the Weekly Estimated Net Usage Systems (WENUS).
Joey Tribbiani asks what Chandler Bing is going to do next.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing does not know.
Chandler Bing says that not knowing what to do is the main issue.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing does not know what Chandler Bing wants to do.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing knows Chandler Bing is not going to figure out what Chandler Bing wants to do by continuing to work at Chandler Bing’s current job.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay has something Chandler Bing can do.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay has a new massage client named Steve (drug addict).
Phoebe Buffay says Steve (drug addict) is opening a restaurant.
Phoebe Buffay says Steve (drug addict) is looking for a head chef.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay knows Monica Geller is a chef.
Phoebe Buffay says Monica Geller is a chef.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay thought of Monica Geller first for the head chef opportunity.
Phoebe Buffay says Chandler Bing is the one who needs a job right now.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing does not have much chef experience.
Chandler Bing says the only restaurant Chandler Bing could handle would be an all‑toast restaurant.
Monica Geller asks what kind of food Steve (drug addict) is looking for at the new restaurant.
Phoebe Buffay says Steve (drug addict) wants to do an eclectic concept.
Phoebe Buffay says Steve (drug addict) is looking for someone to create the entire menu.
Phoebe Buffay asks what Monica Geller thinks about the head chef opportunity.
Chandler Bing thanks Phoebe Buffay for the suggestion.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing does not see himself as a chef wearing a big white hat.
Phoebe Buffay prompts Monica Geller to guess what Phoebe Buffay is about to say.
